limitations: One final training seed; no statistical significance claim.
Teacher has 304,140 parameters and is trained here, not an external state-of-the-art large model.
Original test groups and real crops were also evaluated in the earlier weight-edit study; fresh glyph/UI seeds are new.
Procedural evaluation font files are excluded from procedural training font list; browser docs/code do not have a font-family holdout.
OCR and arbitrary real-video temporal quality were not evaluated.
Teacher integer-pan probe trims only 16 HR pixels, insufficient for its ten-layer receptive field; its discrepancy may include boundary effects.
Original-group scalar metrics average four-image batches; blank batches are excluded from stroke error. PSNR is recomputed from aggregate MSE.
Real crispness uses clamped float predictions and halo scaled by 1000; paired and temporal metrics quantize to 8 bits, paired halo is scaled by 255.
Final student training is FP32 but frozen teacher guidance is computed in FP16.
The training report objective fields were corrected from saved CLI options after training; weights and training behavior were unchanged.
